name: Brand hook card
oneliner: Your opening line on a card in your brand, with the key phrase in your italic.
description: The hook looks like your website: your display font, the important words in its italic and your accent colour, on a card in your brand colour. Reads as yours, not as a template.
prompt: Render with engines/overlays.py, item kind "hook", for the first 2.0-2.5s (end it when the hook sentence ends). Copy: two short lines lifted from the spoken hook in the transcript: "title" (up to 20 characters) and "italic" (the phrase that carries the idea, up to 22 characters); any word you write yourself is flagged for approval in the plan. Look: a card at x=72, y=260, up to 936px wide, radius 30px, padding 52px 64px; "on": "card" = {{brand.primary}} card, or "light" = the brand background colour with a soft shadow. A short {{brand.accent}} rule above the title; title in {{font.display}} 700, 112px (shrinks to no less than 72px to fit one line), tracking -2%; the italic line in the italic of {{font.display}}, 112px, in {{brand.accent}} (or the most vivid brand colour that reads on the card). Motion: card rises 40px and fades in over 550ms (power3 out), the rule wipes in, the title rises, the italic slides in 300ms later; out: fades up over 350ms. Inside the safe zone and clear of the caption band (59-73% of the height). Do NOT uppercase, do NOT add a third line, and do NOT stack it with a signature effect in the same moment.
